title: ReelShort Invitation Code: Where to Enter It
description: Where to enter an invitation code in the ReelShort app, what it does, why free coin generators are scams, and the official ways to earn coins.
h1: ReelShort invitation code: how it really works
lead: ReelShort has an invitation code box for viewers. Here is where it is, what ReelShort itself says about it, and what to avoid.

sections.h2: Where to enter an invitation code
steps: Open the ReelShort app and log in.
Enter the code a friend sent you and tap Redeem.
p: These steps follow ReelShort's own guide. The app can change, so check that guide if a menu has moved.
ReelShort's guide says redeeming gives bonus coins but does not give an amount. Anyone promising a fixed number of coins for a code is guessing or lying.
Sites and videos that promise unlimited coins, hacks or modded apps are scams. They want your login, your phone number or an install. ReelShort does not hand out coins through third-party generators.
ReelShort lists its own ways to earn coins in the app, such as daily check-ins and in-app tasks. See ReelShort's guide for the current list.

links.text: ReelShort: how to earn free coins

sections.h2: Creators: this is a different code
p: If you want to earn by sharing ReelShort dramas, you need the RS Boost creator code, which goes in the RS Boost sign-up form, not in the app.

links.text: RS Boost invite code for creators

faq.q: Where do I enter an invitation code on ReelShort?
faq.a: In the app: Me, then Invitation Code, then enter the code and tap Redeem.

faq.q: How many coins does a ReelShort invitation code give?
faq.a: ReelShort's guide does not state an amount, so we do not either.

faq.q: Are there free ReelShort promo codes that work for everyone?
faq.a: We have not found any official one. Be wary of sites listing many codes with no source.
No. Treat them as scams and never give them your login.
No. We share free parts of dramas and link to ReelShort for the rest.
